pages.text: A Letter of Resignation can be used to leave a $(l:arcanearchives:concepts/networks)Hybrid Network$(/l) created with a $(l:arcanearchives:items/letterinvitation)Letter of Invitation$(/l).$(br2)When you leave a hybrid network, any Radiant Storage you placed is removed from the network, and will no longer be visible on a $(l:arcanearchives:items/manifest)Manifest$(/l) by members of the network you left.
Letters of Resignation can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).

$()$(italic) To my esteemed colleagues of the Eternal University, $()$(br2)$()$(italic) All of my Enlighted existence I have labored tirelessly to bring Enlightenment to all whom the Magistocracy have deemed worthy to share in its light. I have strived to be a beacon of Enlightenment to all, but no longer can I turn a blind eye to the delusions that this University has allowed to fester. $()

$()$(italic) The Enlightenment that the Grand Architects shared was not meant for the vulgar peasantry. Enlightenment is for the pure; we cannot continue to dilute our ranks with crude Novices who will never become anything more than Journeymen. $()$(br2)$()$(italic) Due to the increase of this practice, despite my many protests, I no longer feel that Enlightenment is truly the highest goal of the Council of Masters. $()
$()$(italic) I have decided therefore, to resign from this once great fellowship effective immediately. $()$(br2)$()$(bold) Official Resignation of Master Rashelon $()$(br2)...1634, Spring's Birth
